svg.title: Three evidence-backed Engraphis agent behaviors
svg.desc: A clear three-card summary of deterministic offline fixtures. Focused context returns 808.8 → 218.4 tokens while retaining Recall at 5 of 1.000. A grounded answer returns support for 5/5 answerable questions grounded. An unsupported question safely abstains for 5/5 off-topic questions abstained. Reproduce with eval.chunking_eval and eval.grounded.
